# totoantonio

> totoantonio makes small, focused Mac apps sold without subscriptions or accounts: macEQ, a system-wide audio equalizer; KeyboardS, a keyboard shortcut reference; and Upscape, a private AI image upscaler. Home page: https://totoantonio.pages.dev/

## macEQ

> macEQ is a system-wide audio equalizer for macOS 27, sold as a one-time USD 14.99 purchase with no subscription. It shapes the sound of every app at once — Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Safari, Chrome — with a 10-band EQ, studio stereo processing, and a live spectrum analyzer. It installs no virtual audio driver. Page: https://totoantonio.pages.dev/maceq.html

### What makes macEQ different

- **No virtual audio driver.** macEQ uses Apple's native `CATapDescription` audio tap API — the same mechanism macOS uses for screen recording audio. Nothing is installed into the system, no kernel extension, and no virtual device appears in Sound settings. Turning it off restores the original audio routing in real time.
- **Every app at once.** One system-wide EQ rather than per-app or player-only processing.
- **One-time USD 14.99.** No subscription, no recurring fee, no account.
- **macOS 27 only.** Designed exclusively for Mac, including Bluetooth speakers and AirPods.

### macEQ features

- 10-band parametric equalizer: 32, 64, 125, 250, 500 Hz and 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 kHz at ±12 dB
- Live EQ frequency curve and a separate live spectrum analyzer
- Quick actions: Extra Bass and Clarity, both additive on top of the current curve and fully reversible
- Stereo Width via true Mid-Side processing, 0% mono to 200% super-wide
- Crossfeed, blending 30% of each channel into the opposite ear for headphone comfort
- Spatial Surround, a virtual 5-channel field with an animated speaker diagram
- Dolby Stereo plate reverb for cinematic stereo expansion
- Auto Level, a software AGC holding every track at consistent loudness
- Volume Boost from 100% to 200% beyond the macOS system maximum
- Night Mode, Ambience, Fidelity, and Pitch Shift of ±12 semitones
- Channel Balance with independent left/right level control
- 13 built-in presets: Bass Boost, Deep Bass, Treble Boost, Crisp Treble, Flat, Music, Movie, Gaming, Podcast, Night Mode, V-Shape, Warm, Orchestra
- Unlimited user presets that save the entire session — EQ, spatial, effects, pitch, volume boost and auto level — under one name
- Menu bar access

### macEQ privacy

macEQ processes all audio locally on the device. It does not record, save, store, upload, transmit, sell or share captured audio, and collects no personal data, listening history, analytics or advertising identifiers. It needs no internet connection to work. The macOS permission appears under Screen & System Audio Recording because macOS groups system audio recording under that privacy area; macEQ does not capture screen contents.

### macEQ availability

Sold through Lemon Squeezy: https://totoantonio.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/999957db-ec04-4fe0-9851-130c210706f5 — App Store release coming soon.

## KeyboardS

> KeyboardS is a menu bar app for macOS that lists 200+ keyboard shortcuts across 14 categories. A global ⌘K hotkey opens an instant search panel from any app. It is a static reference — it does not record keystrokes and needs no Input Monitoring permission. Tagline: "Every Mac Shortcut, One Keystroke Away". Page: https://totoantonio.pages.dev/keyboards.html

### What makes KeyboardS different

- **Nothing is watching.** Most shortcut apps observe your keyboard to work. KeyboardS is a reference list you open on purpose, so there is nothing to monitor and nothing to send anywhere.
- **No Input Monitoring permission.** Nothing to approve in Privacy & Security.
- **Menu bar only.** No Dock icon, no window management, open and gone in a second.
- **Ships complete.** The full shortcut list lives inside the app and works offline, with no account.

### KeyboardS features

- Menu bar app with no Dock icon
- Global ⌘K hotkey that opens the panel from any app
- Instant search across every category at once
- 200+ macOS shortcuts written in plain language
- 14 categories, each with a running count: Most Used, Basics, Power, Modifier Keys, Screenshots, System, Spaces, Text, Text Selection, Finder, Finder Navigation, Accessibility, Function Keys, Advanced
- One-click link to Apple's official shortcut reference
- No subscription, no account, works offline

### KeyboardS privacy

KeyboardS does not record keystrokes and never observes what you type. It requires no Input Monitoring permission, no account, and no internet connection.

### KeyboardS availability

Released. Sold through Lemon Squeezy: https://totoantonio.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/a7ed3bb8-9b6f-4d91-94f3-5cfa2776aadd

## Upscape

> Upscape is a private AI image upscaler for Mac. It enhances photos, illustrations, portraits, screenshots and compressed images locally with Core ML, upscaling up to 4x with seven specialized models, batch processing, a before and after comparison slider, and PNG, JPEG, TIFF, HEIC and WebP export. Images are never uploaded and no account is required. Tagline: "Upscale images privately on your Mac". Page: https://totoantonio.pages.dev/upscape.html

### What makes Upscape different

- **Private by design.** Every image is processed locally with Core ML. Files are never uploaded for processing.
- **Seven specialized models** rather than one general-purpose network, so the model matches the source material.
- **Built for Apple Silicon**, running across the GPU, Neural Engine and CPU.
- **Works offline.** Once installed with its models, no internet connection and no account are needed.

### Upscape features

- AI upscaling up to 4x
- Six specialized models: Standard Photo, Illustration, UltraSharp, NMKD Siax CX, Nomos 8K, General v3
- Interactive before and after comparison slider
- Batch upscaling of multiple files in one run
- Export to PNG, JPEG, TIFF, HEIC and WebP
- Reads common macOS image formats including JPEG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC, WebP and RAW
- Optimized for Apple Silicon with GPU, Neural Engine and CPU execution
- No uploads, no account, works offline

### Choosing an Upscape model

Use Standard Photo for most images. Use Illustration for anime or artwork, UltraSharp for architecture and landscapes, NMKD Siax CX for portraits and smooth gradients, Nomos 8K for punchy micro-detail and texture, and General v3 for real-world photos with fewer halos and artifacts.

### Upscape limits

Upscape improves low-resolution, compressed and pixelated images, but it cannot recover detail that was never captured. It works best on images that are small or compressed rather than severely out of focus.

### Upscape availability

Coming soon to Lemon Squeezy.
